adaptations.description: Requires arterial blood gases, adds ventilated PaO2/FiO2 below 300 and below 400 branches, and takes the worse supported/unsupported category.
Computes only the MAP, platelet, bilirubin, creatinine, urine and GCS aggregates used by SOFA with the same upstream boundary predicates.
Scores only positive vasoactive rates from recorded infusion episodes lasting at least one hour, as required by the original SOFA definition.

known_preserved_behaviors: Laboratory and physiological window is inclusive from ICU intime minus 6 hours through intime plus 24 hours.
Urine output is inclusive from ICU intime through intime plus 24 hours and is not normalized for short stays.
Vasopressors are selected by infusion starttime within the first-day window and require total recorded duration of at least one hour.
Only blood gases marked ART. by the pinned blood-gas concept are eligible.
Missing component scores are retained as null but contribute zero to the total.
